about.storyP1: Marrow Tang, 90s designer,She earned her Master's degree in Fashion Design from Beijing Institute of Fashion Technology. Her evening gown design was shortlisted for the 2014 ARTS OF FASHION Prize by the American Fashion Arts Foundation. In 2016, she founded the bridal design brand Marrow in Chengdu.
about.storyP2: In 2019, Marrow was selected for the bridal wear segment of Shanghai International Fashion Week. At the same year, Marrow received the Annual Craftsmanship Brand Award in China's wedding fashion industry from COSMO BRIDE magazine. She loves vintage and modern multiculture at the same time, Combining retro culture and fashion design with her imagination. Each series unfolds like a vivid and charming movie story.
about.storyP3: In 2025, Marrow was recognized by THE WED, the world-renowned wedding magazine website, as one of the 20 Next-Gen Bridal Designers You Need on Your Radar. In 2026, Marrow was named one of Asia’s 14 Best Bridal Designer by THE WED.
about.storyP4: Marrow Tang has always been drawn to the space where past and present blur. Since launching her Chengdu-based namesake label in 2016, the designer has built a bridal world shaped by multicultural references, retro sensibility, and a quietly modern eye — collections that evoke another era without being costumed by it. With an emphasis on natural comfort, impeccable tailoring, and luxurious fabrics, each piece by Marrow feels thoughtfully composed yet effortlessly wearable.
